newsitem.title: USA: Aastrom Biosciences price range cut.
newsitem.headline: Aastrom Biosciences price range cut.

text.p: Aastrom Biosciences Inc has cut the estimated price range for shares in its initial public offering, according to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
The range is now $7 to $8 a share. It had previously been estimated at $8 to $10. The number of shares to be offered, 3.25 million, remains the same.
The company develops technologies and devices for a range of cell therapy applications including gene therapy.
The deal is tentatively scheduled to price on Monday for trading on Tuesday, according to lead underwriter Cowen & Co.
